data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 4242 reported gross claims outstanding at 31 December 2018 of approximately 348.6 (thousand-currency units = 348.61 million in native currency). The report references material exposure to US hurricane events in 2017 and 2018 (Harvey, Irma, Florence, Michael). A gross claims development (triangle) is present in the notes but the document did not provide a clearly labelled gross prior-year movement figure in a readily-extractable form; therefore no single gross prior-year development amount could be unambiguously determined from the scanned pages.
raw_causal_phrases: The Syndicate has material exposure to natural catastrophe events.
Hurricanes Florence and Michael which occurred in the 2018 calendar year and to a lesser extent Hurricanes Harvey and Irma which occurred in the 2017 calendar year.
data.data_quality_notes: Document provided as scanned images with limited legibility. Balance sheet / technical provisions pages were readable enough to extract the gross claims outstanding at 31 Dec 2018 (closing 2018 = opening 2019) as c. 348,610 (thousands) => 348.61m (native currency). No clear, unambiguous GROSS 'movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' figure was found in the accessible text; the Profit & Loss contains 'claims incurred in prior underwriting years' (P&L concept) which must not be used for prior-year reserve movement per the instructions. A gross claims development triangle is present (pages ~41-42) but the scan quality prevented reliable numeric extraction of the diagonal differences needed to compute prior-year development; therefore prior_year_development_gbp_m is left null. Many other numeric tables were partially legible but ambiguous; users should consult the original PDF for authoritative figures.
